title: Paul McCartney live: Fenway Park, Boston | 2022
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Fenway Park in Boston, Massachusetts, USA, on 8 June 2022.

It was the 14th show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025, and the second of two consecutive nights in Boston.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

McCartney had previously performed at Fenway Park on 5 and 6 August 2009 during the Summer Live ’09 Tour; 9 July 2013 for the Out There Tour; and 17 July 2016 for the One On One Tour.
